editorial:
Imagine being so rich that you think you can just buy a new personality for your girlfriend. That is exactly what happens here when a wealthy man decides his partner is too unrefined for his high-society friends. He hires a smart journalist to teach her how to talk and act like an upper-class lady. It starts off as a funny setup where you see this woman go from a simple showgirl to someone who can hold her own in any room. The vibe is light and breezy, making it a great choice for a relaxed night in when you just want something easy to watch.

You will really enjoy seeing the power shift as the girlfriend gains confidence and starts questioning everything. The acting is great, and the chemistry between the leads keeps the story moving quickly. While some of the jokes feel a bit dated, the message about independence still hits home. You should definitely check this out if you like romantic comedies with a bit of a bite. It looks great if you can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a solid choice for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: The plan backfires completely when the girlfriend uses her new education to stand up for herself. Instead of becoming a quiet trophy wife, she realizes she is smarter than her millionaire boyfriend. She calls him out for his arrogance and decides she does not need his money or his control. In the end, she chooses her own independence and finds a real connection with the journalist who actually respects her mind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic rom-coms and stories about personal growth.
